Report Description/// UPDATE TO REPORT # 1320333 /// UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: AMOUNT OF NATURAL GAS RELEASED IS 32.7 DTH ORIGINAL REPORT READS: ///THIS IS A 48 HOUR UPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1320131/// THE UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: INCIDENT CAUSE: CHANGED FROM UNKNOWN TO OTHER REMEDIAL ACTION: RELEASE IS SECURED, INVESTIGATION IS COMPLETE MATERIAL RELEASE: CHANGED FROM POTENTIAL TO ACTUAL DESCRIPTION OF INCIDENT: THE HALF INCH PLASTIC SERVICE PIPELINE WAS INSERTED INTO A 1 AN 1 QUARTER INCH STEEL SERVICE PIPELINE. THE HOME OWNER DUG A FIRE PIT AND THE STEEL CASING WAS AT THE BOTTOM OF THE FIRE PIT. THE HOME OWNER HAD A FIRE IN THE FIRE PIT CAUSING THE 1/2 INCH PLASTIC SERVICE LINE TO MELT. THIS CAUSED THE GAS TO TRAVEL IN THE OLD STEEL LINE TO TRAVEL TO THE RESIDENCE. THE HOME OWNER SMELLED GAS THE NIGHT BEFORE AND THE DAY OF AND DID NOT CALL THE OPERATOR. THE MORNING OF THE EXPLOSION THE HOME OWNER TRIED TO LIGHT A CIGARETTE CAUSING THE EXPLOSION. ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION OF INCIDENT: CALLER STATES THERE WAS A FIRE AND EXPLOSION AT A RESIDENTIAL HOME. THERE IS A POTENTIAL FOR NATURAL GAS TO RELEASE FROM A DISTRIBUTION PIPELINE TO THE ATMOSPHERE. CALLER STATES THERE 4 INJURIES SENT TO THE HOSPITAL BUT NO FATALITIES. WEST MICHIGAN STREET WAS CLOSED E/W. THAT WAS ALL THE INFORMATION THE CALLER PROVIDED.

***WEB REPORT*** THIS IS AN UPDATE OF A REPORT MADE EARLIER TODAY IR #1008229 REGARDING A SHEEN OF UNKNOWN ORIGIN. THE ORIGIN OF THE SHEEN WAS SUBSEQUENTLY DETERMINED AT APPROX. 10:00 TO BE FROM A LEAKING VALVE ABOARD THE THUNDER HORSE PDQ. THE LEAKING MATERIAL WAS FROM A RECYCLE LINE PUMPING WATER CLARIFIER CHEMICAL USED IN THE PDQ WASTEWATER TREATMENT FLOAT CELL, AND CONTAINED A SMALL AMOUNT OF ENTRAINED OIL. THE PDQ WAS IN THE PROCESS OF A GAS PIPELINE SHUTING, AND THE VALVE FAILED TO CLOSE 100% RESULTING IN THE LEAK. UPON DISCOVERY THE VALVE WAS CLOSED AND THE LEAK WAS STOPPED. THE ESTIMATED RELEASE AMOUNT FOR THE INCIDENT IS 58 POUNDS IN 1 HOUR. - THE CALLER UPDATES THE RELEASE WAS DISCOVERED THIS MORNING 6/11/21, FROM A DRONE VIDEO INSPECTION VIDEO THAT WAS CONDUCTED/DATED 5/5/21. SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 30.159705, -95.454667 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Reported Spill Volume: 3 gallons
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** A PREVIOUS MINERAL OIL SPILL FROM A PAD MOUNT TRANSFORMER AT THIS LOCATION (3-31-12) DEPOSITED APPROXIMATELY 4 GALLONS OF MINERAL OIL INTO AN UNDERGROUND CONDUIT. APPROXIMATELY 1 GALLON OF THIS OIL WAS ABLE TO BE REMOVED FROM THE CONDUIT AT THAT TIME. IT WAS DISCOVERED TODAY (4-16-12) AROUND 10:00 THAT RAIN HAD DISPLACED THE REMAINING 3 GALLONS OF MINERAL OIL IN THE CONDUIT. THIS OIL/WATER MIXTURE CAME OUT OF THE CONDUIT ONTO THE SIDE OF THE STREET AND THEN INTO A STORM DRAIN. OUR SPILL CONTRACTORS HAVE RESPONDED. THEY USED BOOM TO BLOCK THE STORM DRAIN AND ABSORBAL TO REMOVE THE OIL FROM THE STREET. THEY ARE ALSO EXCAVATING SOIL AND VEGETATION THAT THE OIL GOT ONTO. THIS SPILL HAS BEEN REPORTED TO TCEQ REGION 12 ON THEIR ANSWERING MACHINE.
